evals.name: basic-report
evals.expected_output: Token breakdown by category with percentages, workflow type detected, and at least one actionable recommendation

evals.name: optimize-with-confirmation
evals.expected_output: Agent shows proposal before applying, pauses for confirmation when a full->exclude change is proposed

evals.name: prior-cold-start
evals.expected_output: When no prior exists for detected workflow, agent falls back to flag-based heuristics and notes that this is session 1 of learning

evals.name: prior-warm-start
evals.prompt: Run /context report and tell me what the prior says about this codebase
evals.expected_output: Agent surfaces the prior for the detected workflow type, including session count and learned patterns

evals.name: learn-after-session
evals.prompt: /context diff — I just finished a debugging session, it went well
evals.expected_output: Agent updates workflow-priors.yaml with outcome=success, reports what patterns were reinforced
